title: Shared Notes Malware
scenario: A class notes link asks you to install a viewer extension before downloading.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Shared Notes Malware: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Extensions can steal browser sessions and passwords.
